_README: FILL IN every value written in [SQUARE BRACKETS] before deploying. `pnpm build` refuses to run while any placeholder remains — see apps/site/README.md.

offer._comment: There is deliberately no `spotsRemaining` here any more (launch-readiness-11). It was a hand-maintained literal that gated the live form from a compiled-in constant, so closing the offer meant a commit, a full CI run and an on-box deploy — and the number on the page was wrong the moment a place was promised. How many places are left is now a question only the control plane can answer, and it answers it: the API counts accepted applications. `spotsTotal` stays because five is a promise, not a measurement.

legal._comment: Bump ONLY when the text of privacy.el.md or programme-terms.el.md actually changes. It is displayed on those pages AND stored with every consent, so auto-dating it on each rebuild would claim revisions that never happened.
